## The Project

OpenPVA is an open-source platform for transparent, modular population
viability analysis. It modernises the construction-system idea demonstrated by
GAPPS through ordinary R process composition and reproducible contracts.

## People

**Lead Developer:** Barry W. Brook  
**Contributors:** Community process modules are welcome as the public contract
stabilises.

## Status

The generic process engine, canonical synthetic benchmark, explicit density,
patch-transition, introduction and optional exact-pedigree modules are active.
YAML, targets and reporting reconnection is deferred to Stage 4.
